plugins.name: cc-usage
plugins.description: Track Claude Code usage (tokens, notional cost, active-time) per session/project/Jira label and upload to the team dashboard. Metadata only; no Jira connection. Adds /task, /burn, /cc-usage-login, and /cc-usage-doctor.
